description: bf16 [13]: large magnitudes and tails in bf16.
reference: F.gelu(x) in f64, rounded once to the dtype
notes: x = -5 and -6 are left out: there torch's own bf16 kernel misses rtol 1e-2 (1 + erf cancels in f32), so the case couldn't check it. f16/bf16 compute in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8). out is computed in f64 from the inputs and params and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
